falsifier: a restore that vaults the number past a milestone without landing on it, or repaints a frozen date
source: EC-FRZ-19: previous_streak 22, broken_on grey, two frozen dates snowflaked. The `frozenInUncovered` block attacks the repaint guard directly: freeze-covered days never reach `uncoveredDays` through the walk, so the guard is only reachable from a hand-built record -- which is precisely the state a future schema migration or a hand-written fixture can produce.
mustNotBe: a `recovered` glyph on a frozen date, or more than one milestone screen
